failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' is correct and exists on the contact form page. Update the selector if the application UI has changed or fix the test if the selector is incorrect.

recommendations: Review the application UI to confirm the presence and correctness of the '[data-test="nav-contact"]' attribute on the expected element.
